listing.name: Complete Vanilla Overhaul Mod Pack
listing.aiSummary: Overhauls system generation, vanilla balance, and adds new ships and weapons.

description:
This modpack contains 3 mods

- Starsector PROCGEN overhaul Fringe Worlds

- Starsector balance overhaul Fever Dream Balancing

- Starsector HORRIBLE WEAPONS pack which contains 2 new ships, 1 fighter and 1 new weapon wing to be used by Core World factions

aiDescription: Overhauls system generation, vanilla balance, and adds new ships and weapons. Includes three distinct mods: Fringe Worlds, Fever Dream Balancing, and Horrible Weapons. Designed for 0.97 but playable on 0.98.

changelog.02.04.2025:
- Ported to 0.98
- Nerfed added Core Worlds a bit. Moved them a bit too (this is to prevent them from looking like self-inserts)
- Removed False Prophet and Death Lord colonies
- Added a new system called Abbadon. A distant Persean League system
- Reworked Tyle (is that what it's called? I'm sorry if I... I'm sorry) into a trinary system with a black hole, a blue giant and a brown dwarf
- Nerfed Warthog, Broadsword and Cactus by giving them finite flux instead of very high flux venting stats
- Increased Centurion's armour by 150 and hull durability by 1k to justify its 5 DP cost
- Lowered Hound's flux capacity by 500
- Reworked Anubis. Has 0.7 shields, costs 30 DP, significantly reduced Design Compromises penalties. Increased base hangar bays from 1 to 2. MIGHT BE OVERPOWERED! FEEDBACK APPRECIATED
- Edited descriptions a bit
- Reverted Fulgent and Glimmer now have High Energy Focus again. Fulgent is 11 DP. Lumen now has plasma jets
- Modified the new Brilliant variant to be Tachyon Lance focused, as the default one was already Paladin PD focused
- Unnerfed Devastator to shooting 6 projectiles again
- Removed additional lava planet variants from spawning pool. They still exist, but they will no longer randomly generate
- Restored the base lava variant to default look from vanilla as the new look is clashing too much with the game's artstyle
changelog.HOTFIX 27.03.2025:
- Not reuploading the whole batch, just fringe worlds was replaced in the current one
- Added specific conditions to one of the planets in populated worlds
- Reverted Null's and Fameless' descriptions to past ones which were better and less confusing
- Fixed some typos specifically in the Yendore system
changelog.24.03.2025:
- Gave Aurora 0.6 shields and a singular hangar bay to have something to use its spare OP on after it has had its large missile removed
- Reverted Destroyers being 2 DP cheaper. They are now all priced similarly to vanilla
- Exceptions are Drover (12 DP), Harbinger (14 DP)
- Changed lower Remnant's systems. Fulgent and Glimmer now have plasma jets. Lumen's mobility has been greatly increased, and it now has High Energy Focus
- AMB reverted to having vanilla firerate
- Plasma Cannon reverted to having simply twice as slower firing mechanics in favour of higher projectile damage. But at the cost of slower projectile speed as it was a few patches ago
- Changed Heavy Mortar to fire 4 projectiles again
- Nerfed Phase Lance by decreasing its turn rate by 33%
- Shifted flux stats of civilian ships a little. For example reduced flux venting of Tarsus by 50
- Reduced flux venting of Condor by 50 from the buffed value
- Reduced flux capacity of Vanguard, Hound, Cerberus by 500 from the buffed value
- Increased flux capacity of Wayfarer by 500
- Increased Gemini's flux capacity by 1k and flux venting by 50
- Changed the probability of ruins occurring on planets to now be increased by stuff like habitable. But reduced the chance of it occurring overall
- Changed the volatile and organics boost to now be tied to cold and very cold instead of poor light and dark
- (previously unmentioned) reduced Flux Regulation and Crew Training to their vanilla values
- Removed B-Deck from Scintilla
- Restored AI tip for Temporal Shell that fools it into thinking it has bonus movement speed (though I inputted a different value, should probably revert it to vanilla next time)
- Rebalanced PTS values for cruisers and capital ships again to make them appear more sporadically in NPC generated fleets. Making bounties and other kinds of encounters more easy to deal with
edit:
Forgot to mention:
- Mercenary military doctrine has been increased to be maximum size so that they no longer break story encounters with how weak they are
